bestFor: Broad RPSGT foundation across physiology, patient care, recording, scoring, testing, treatment, pediatrics, quality, and sleep-center operations.
copyrightUse: Chapter and appendix titles plus original SPG study directions only; do not reproduce textbook prose, figures, tables, or review questions.
mappingBoundary: Exact question IDs are mapped by matching these source keys in referenceKeys or studyRecommendationKeys, then grouped by taskCode. Chapter rows point to those task pools and still require editorial page-level verification.
